name: sumsec-skills
description: SummerSec personal Agent Skills marketplace. Plugins: writing-zh, media-tools, dev-tools, agents-dev, claude-code-setup, claude-md-management, hookify, plugin-dev, cloudflare-email, and taste-skill. Install what you need.

plugins.name: writing-zh
plugins.description: Chinese writing tools: humanizer-zh (de-AIify text), creating-blog-web-ppt (Markdown to HTML slides), khazix-writer (personal voice long-form writing), and sumsec-illustrations (SumSec article illustrations).

plugins.name: media-tools
plugins.description: Media generation: draw-image-generation (AI images via Right.Codes API) and remotion-best-practices (React video).

plugins.name: dev-tools
plugins.description: Developer tools: git-commit-pr, agent-chat-history, context7-cli/mcp/find-docs, Ponytail minimal-solution skills, a bundled Ponytail MCP server, frontend-design, and baoyu-design.

plugins.name: claude-code-setup
plugins.description: Analyze codebases and recommend tailored Claude Code automations: hooks, skills, MCP servers, subagents, and slash commands.

plugins.name: claude-md-management
plugins.description: Maintain and improve CLAUDE.md files: audit quality (claude-md-improver) and capture session learnings (/revise-claude-md).

plugins.name: hookify
plugins.description: Create hooks to prevent unwanted behaviors by analyzing conversation patterns. Supports regex matching, multiple event types, and interactive rule management.

plugins.name: plugin-dev
plugins.description: Plugin development toolkit: 7 skills (agent/command/hook/skill/MCP/structure/settings) + 3 agents (agent-creator, plugin-validator, skill-reviewer) + /plugin-dev:create-plugin guided workflow.

plugins.name: cloudflare-email
plugins.description: Cloudflare temp mail agent skill for reading inbox messages, fetching parsed mail, and sending email with an Address JWT.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Frontend design taste skills for distinctive layouts, redesigns, image-to-code, brand systems, and visual direction.
